title: StateBros' Music
description: Add more music dics to the game, made my me and some of my friends. Mainly with SUNO AI.
body:
# StateBros' Music 

Adds a huge collection of brand-new music discs to the base game of Minecraft, giving players more songs to discover, collect, and listen to while exploring their worlds! Whether you're building massive cities, mining deep underground, fighting mobs, or just relaxing at your base, this mod brings extra atmosphere and variety to your Minecraft experience.

Most of the tracks included in this mod were created using Suno AI, helping bring unique styles and sounds into the game. Some tracks may also be fully original or created with other tools and methods — you’ll have to download the mod and listen for yourself to discover them all!

The mod is constantly growing, with more music discs planned for future updates. Expect new songs, different genres, special themed tracks, and more surprises over time as development continues.

Current music contributions include tracks by Webhead_109, with even more custom music planned in upcoming releases!

Features
Brand-new collectible music discs
Multiple music styles and themes
Fits naturally into vanilla Minecraft gameplay
More discs and songs added over time
Great for survival, creative, multiplayer, and roleplay worlds

Download StateBros' Music today and give your Minecraft world a brand-new soundtrack!
